import { Controller, Injectable, Module, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectQueue, Processor, WorkerHost } from '@nestjs/bullmq';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Job, Queue } from 'bullmq';
import { Entity, PrimaryColumn, Repository } from 'typeorm';

@Entity('worker_receipt')
class WorkerReceipt {
  @PrimaryColumn()
  declare id: string;
}

@Entity('generated_pdf')
class GeneratedPdf {
  @PrimaryColumn()
  declare id: string;
}

@Entity('cleanup_receipt')
class CleanupReceipt {
  @PrimaryColumn()
  declare id: string;
}

@Injectable()
class ReportsProducer {
  constructor(
    @InjectQueue('reports')
    private readonly reports: Queue<{ readonly id: string }, void, string>,
  ) {}

  async generate(id: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.reports.add('generate-pdf', { id });
  }

  async cleanup(id: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.reports.add('cleanup', { id });
  }
}

@Controller('reports')
class ReportsController {
  constructor(private readonly producer: ReportsProducer) {}

  @Post('generate')
  async generate(): Promise<void> {
    await this.producer.generate('generate-1');
  }

  @Post('cleanup')
  async cleanup(): Promise<void> {
    await this.producer.cleanup('cleanup-1');
  }
}

@Processor('reports')
class ReportsProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(WorkerReceipt)
    private readonly receipts: Repository<WorkerReceipt>,
    @InjectRepository(GeneratedPdf)
    private readonly generated: Repository<GeneratedPdf>,
    @InjectRepository(CleanupReceipt)
    private readonly cleanupReceipts: Repository<CleanupReceipt>,
  ) {
    super();
  }

  async process(job: Job<{ readonly id: string }, unknown, string>): Promise<void> {
    await this.receipts.save({ id: job.data.id });
    switch (job.name) {
      case 'generate-pdf': {
        await this.generated.save({ id: job.data.id });
        return;
      }
      case 'cleanup': {
        await this.cleanupReceipts.save({ id: job.data.id });
        return;
      }
      default:
        return;
    }
  }
}

@Module({
  controllers: [ReportsController],
  providers: [ReportsProducer, ReportsProcessor],
})
class ReportsModule {}

const __PHASE40_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('Phase 40 BullMQ fixture must never execute');
})();
void __PHASE40_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
